name: the unversioned-tick finding is renamed, so the fail-open it names is no longer reported as one
expect: a tick with no VERIFIED AGAINST is reported, never silently skipped

name: staleness compares with <= so a tick against the CURRENT release reads as stale
expect: a tick verified against the current release is clean

name: ticked items are no longer skipped for falsifiers, so done work is demanded a FAILS IF
expect: ticked items are out of scope

name: investigation phrasing loses its specific diagnosis and reports as a plain missing falsifier
expect: investigation phrasing is called out specifically

name: unknown npm scripts stop being flagged, so a gate can name a command that does not exist
expect: an unknown npm script is flagged
